title: Christmas at Grandma’s House
about: A nostalgic Christmas visit filled with the particular warmth and chaos of Grandma's house.
description: A nostalgic Christmas visit filled with the particular warmth and chaos of Grandma's house. A playful original Christmas song drawn from family stories and holiday traditions.
lyrics: But the warmest glow of all
Is the one inside her home for me.
Every year the door is open,
Just as strong as it is now.
Where the joy begins at dawn.
And we stay ‘til the day is gone.
Peace stays when the night grows long -
Feels like a blessing wrapped in love
One truth still rings so clear -
Is the reason we feel home here.
Where love has lived so long.
For the love you always gave.
